description: SciGRID_gas is a family of open data sets describing the European gas transport network, produced by the SciGRID_gas project at the DLR Institute of Networked Energy Systems to give energy system modellers an open-data model of the gas grid built only from freely available sources. Source data sets (INET_Raw from internet sources, GIE_Raw, EMAP_Raw, LKD_Raw and others) were collected, processed and merged, and statistical and heuristic methods fill missing attributes; the combined IGGIELGN and IGGIELGNC releases merge INET, Gas Infrastructure Europe, Gas Storages Europe, International Gas Union, LKD, Great Britain and Norway data. The project paper reports about 237,000 km of pipelines plus compressor stations, LNG terminals, storages, production sites, gas power plants, border points and demand time series. Coverage is Europe. Each release is a zipped data set on Zenodo (IGGIELGNC-3 version 0.2 of June 2021, about 23 MB) under CC-BY-4.0 at no cost. Caveats: many attributes are estimated, not observed, so values such as diameters and capacities should be treated as approximations, and the Zenodo records have not been updated since March 2022. Simulation uses are gas network flow models, capacity planning and resilience studies of the European gas supply. Related records: none linked on the provider's pages read on the day.
